note: Sonoma Coast State Park campground on Wright's Beach north of Bodega Bay, the front row on the back of the open sand; paved spurs. No RV water fill: fill tanks at Bodega Dunes, about 5 miles south, which also has the dump station and token showers that Wright's Beach campers may use. The surf here is not for swimming. --Claude
summary: Wright's Beach (Sonoma Coast SP): $45 every night checked; 27 sites, 27-ft trailer limit; FCFS inside 48 hours; coastal dunes KEPT - Hwy 1 is inland of the camp, front row on open beach sand ~100 m from surf; closed Nov 16-30 2026 for storm swells and every site blocked on ReserveCalifornia to Dec 10.
flags: WATERFRONT coastal dunes KEPT: Highway 1 runs inland (east) of the campground, no town and no day-use between the front row and the shore; the front sites (premium WB01-WB10, around 38.4005,-123.0958) sit at the back edge of open beach sand ~90-110 m from the wet sand. A case could be made for an on-water value (no buffer at all), but the apron is twice the ~50 m bound, so coastal dunes stays. Proposed evidence: 'Esri imagery + topo 2026-11-26: Hwy 1 inland of camp; front row (WB01-WB10) on the back of open Wright's Beach sand, ~100 m to surf, nothing between; parks.ca.gov: 27 sites adjacent to the beach.'
